graphify-reconciliation-recovery-and-rea.title: Repair rebased semantic CLI compatibility, then harden upstream intake
graphify-reconciliation-recovery-and-rea.enteredLaneBecause: The completed upstream rebase has unresolved targeted validation and the requested reusable process hardening crosses repository and shared fork-manager boundaries.
exitCriteria: Track A is validation-clean, independently reviewed, and its active CLI is reinstalled and source-verified.
Track B ownership is decided after inventorying the shared OSS fork-manager surface.
Mase explicitly authorizes any Track B implementation envelope; planning alone does not authorize mutations.
graphify-reconciliation-recovery-and-rea.nextAction: Track A is complete. Await separate authorization to inventory the canonical shared OSS fork-manager owner before any Track B automation design or implementation.
approvalGates: Do not start another rebase, fetch, pull, reset, abort, push, active-CLI reinstall, or consumer-repo propagation without explicit authority.
Track A must be validation-clean before a fresh upstream reconciliation is considered.
Track B automation is conditional on confirming the canonical shared OSS fork-manager owner; do not assume a Graphify CLI command is the right shared solution.
Local commits require a separate explicit commit-capable workflow or request.
